feed.title: Bullpen Phone: Chicago White Sox reporter posts

entry.title: Dustin May: The Dodgers traded Dustin May to the Red Sox at the 2025 trade deadline rather than put him in the bullpen. He is 8-13, 4.81 in 37 games/36 starts with three teams since. May agreed to a three-year/$52.5 million deal with the White Sox today. Get your kid pitching lessons.
